summary: Tested iteration 25 features end-to-end: auto proforma at Dosar ANRE order (DEN-PF-YYYY-NNNN, 3200 + 21% VAT = 3872, service:true, PDF with service line), two-way payment sync between dossier and invoice (no subscription change), official ANRE template admin (list/upload/delete/file, 403 for subscriber, 400 for invalid/unknown key), docx filling of {{firma}}/{{cui}} plus a repeated {{p.*}} table row (one row per staff, numbered 1..N), PDF fallback when no template, ZIP package containing personal.docx, operator visa_date save/reset/admin confirm, and the anre-visa cron (401 without secret, one reminder only, run-id duplicate detection, no reminder for dates more than 60 days out). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass. Frontend: admin templates panel upload/help/delete, admin operator visa column confirm, subscriber unpaid dossier view (transfer + proforma PDF link returns 200) and OperatorAttest visa input with status change all work.

minor.issue: Marks the dossier 'plătit' even when its invoice is cancelled/refunded, and cancelling the invoice later does not revert the dossier.
Field detection (fields/matched) only scans body paragraphs and top-level table cells. fill_docx also fills headers/footers and nested tables, so the 'câmpuri recunoscute' count can be too low.
The whole paragraph text is collapsed into the first run, so mixed formatting is lost after filling (e.g. a bold label followed by a normal value). This can visibly change official ANRE forms.
The proforma is created before the dossier is inserted, which could leave an orphan invoice if the insert fails. Low risk.

issues: Table headers have no spacing between them: 'DocumentVizare periodică' and 'VerificatStatus și observații' run together.
Amounts are shown unformatted ('3200 lei + TVA (3872 lei)', 'Suma: 3872 lei'), while the PDF uses '3 200,00 RON'. Use Romanian number formatting.

action_items: Optional: keep the dossier and invoice in sync when an invoice is cancelled or refunded, and refuse anre_pay when the invoice is cancelled.
Optional: preserve run formatting when filling docx placeholders (replace only inside runs when the placeholder is not split across runs).
Optional: include headers/footers and nested tables in template field detection.
Fix header spacing in the AdminOperators table and format lei amounts in AnreEditor.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_routes.py is 762 lines (over the 700-line guideline); consider splitting out the proforma/service invoice and SmartBill logic.
Placeholders use double braces {{key}}, not single braces {key} as the review request says. The UI help text shows {{firma}}, so admins are told correctly.
If the visa reminder email fails, nothing is recorded and it is retried the next day. This is correct for idempotency, but there is no admin-visible failure log.
Emails to @example.com are blocked by managed email (422 undeliverable_recipient). Tests use delivered@resend.dev for the visa reminder.
